title: M1 cloud parity: claude-dotfiles
description: A claude.ai/code session on this repo has full functional parity with a session on the desktop: every governance hook, skill, tracker tool, git and GitHub write, and test suite works from a container with no PC step. Proving ground for M2. Map #154, spec #207.

title: M2 cloud parity: all repos
description: The same parity for every AAC repo: the harness delivers the bootstrap hook and permission posture, each repo cuts over (#219 to #225), the four masters run on cloud Routines, and the PC is retired as a session venue. Map #154, spec #207.

title: Backlog
description: Open work that is not on the cloud-parity path. Exists so every open issue carries a milestone: with more than one open milestone the issue metadata audit comments on each unmilestoned issue, and the tracker audit reports it as drift.
